origin: Agent-authored development contrasts after inspecting a failed diagnostic; not independent accuracy labels.
policy: Distinguish content error from transfer of a claim explicitly owned by another actor. A question, hypothetical, or report about the user is not by itself another actor owning that calculation. Full user support takes precedence over matching other-actor text. Unknown ownership and numerical overlap alone do not prove reversal.
label_review_status: Independent adjudication pending; all expectations are disclosed proposals, particularly the three marked boundary interpretations.
